items.name: date-field-shadcn
items.title: Date field (shadcn Input)
items.description: ictus useDateFieldMask wired to a shadcn Input. Installs into your components folder; keep your Input styles.
items.docs: Requires a shadcn project with Input already available (this item pulls `input`). Then: npx shadcn@latest add flixlix/ictus/date-field-shadcn

items.name: date-field-base-ui
items.title: Date field (Base UI)
items.description: ictus useDateFieldMask on Base UI Field + Input. Headless mask, Base UI chrome.

items.name: date-field-day-picker
items.title: Date field (Day Picker + popover)
items.description: Masked text input plus a Base UI popover calendar powered by react-day-picker. Typing and picking stay in sync.
items.docs: Install: npx shadcn@latest add flixlix/ictus/date-field-day-picker. Import react-day-picker/style.css once in your app if the calendar looks unstyled.
